cues: The logarithmic series behaves differently: it only works for x between minus one and one, including one.
At x equal to one the partial sums zig zag, above and below, closing in on log two.
At x equal to minus one point two the terms grow and the sums run away: no sum at all.
That is why the condition must always be stated.
